title: Grounding in the Dark: Text-Only Training for Zero-Shot Video Temporal Localization
abstract: arXiv:2611.06149v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Video-LLMs are typically trained on paired video-text data for temporal tasks, yet collecting precise temporal annotations and training on large-scale video datasets are both costly. We investigate whether a text-only LLM, with no vision-language pretraining, can be trained on textual video descriptions alone to perform temporal grounding and receive video only at inference time. This setting removes paired video data from training altogether and is a step toward training multimodal models without paired annotations. We generate a 134K-example corpus of textual sequences with up to 100 time steps, adapt Qwen3-8B with LoRA on CLIP or LLM2CLIP text embeddings, and evaluate on Charades-STA and QV-Highlights without training on videos from either benchmark. LLM2CLIP, whose text encoder supports longer inputs, represents detailed descriptions better than CLIP (61.54 versus 53.86 mtIoU on Temporal-TextVid) and transfers them better to video.

translated_title: 在黑暗中定位：仅用文本训练实现零样本视频时序定位
translated_abstract: 视频-语言大模型（Video-LLMs）通常在配对的视频-文本数据上进行时序任务训练，然而收集精确的时序标注以及在大规模视频数据集上训练都非常昂贵。我们研究了一个没有经过视觉-语言预训练的纯文本大语言模型，是否能够仅通过文本形式的视频描述进行训练来执行时序定位，并只在推理阶段接收视频输入。这种设置在训练中完全去除了配对的视频数据，是迈向无需配对标注的多模态模型训练的一步。我们生成了一个包含13.4万条样本、最多100个时间步的文本序列语料库，使用LoRA基于CLIP或LLM2CLIP文本嵌入对Qwen3-8B进行适配，并在Charades-STA和QV-Highlights上进行评估，且未在这两个基准的任何视频上进行训练。LLM2CLIP的文本编码器支持更长的输入，比CLIP能更好地表示详细描述（在Temporal-TextVid上mtIoU为61.54对53.86），并能将其更好地迁移到视频上。
tldr: 提出一种仅用文本视频描述训练大语言模型（无需配对视频数据和视觉-语言预训练）来实现零样本视频时序定位的方法，通过LoRA在LLM2CLIP文本嵌入上适配Qwen3-8B，在推理时才首次接触视频即可取得优异的时序定位效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes training a text-only LLM solely on textual video descriptions—without paired video data or vision-language pretraining—for zero-shot video temporal localization, adapting Qwen3-8B with LoRA on LLM2CLIP text embeddings and achieving strong performance while first seeing videos only at inference time.
